source: 17 ordered BTCUSDT USD-M futures bookTicker and aggTrades days admitted by btc_microstructure_admission_20260925.json
interpretation: Tests BBO withdrawal and taker-flow information. Does not identify cancellations, forced liquidations, or global BTC liquidity.

clock.decisions: one per minute at second 00, starting 00:02 and ending 23:58
clock.book_state: latest BBO by event_time <= decision; ignore rows outside the archive UTC date
clock.trade_state: aggregate trades with transact_time in [decision-30s, decision)
clock.features: all quote and trade observations at or before decision; no same-second trades after decision
clock.label: midpoint at decision+60s versus midpoint at decision
clock.quote_freshness: book event age <= 1s at decision, decision-30s, decision-60s, decision+60s, entry, and exit
clock.execution: enter at decision+1s quote and exit at decision+61s quote; both require event age <= 1s

withdrawal_test.outcome: next-60s absolute midpoint return exceeds the training-only 90th percentile
withdrawal_test.model: standardized logistic regression, L2 C=1, class_weight=None, fixed seed 19
withdrawal_test.primary_metric: historical-test average precision increment over shared baseline
withdrawal_test.secondary_metric: Brier score increment; date-level average precision increments
withdrawal_test.pass_gate: AP improvement > 0.02, Brier no worse, and positive AP increment on at least 6 of 8 historical-test dates

aggression_test.outcome: sign of next-60s midpoint return, excluding exact ties
aggression_test.model: standardized logistic regression, L2 C=1, class_weight=None, fixed seed 19
aggression_test.primary_metric: historical-test ROC AUC increment over shared baseline
aggression_test.secondary_metric: Brier score increment; date-level AUC increments
aggression_test.pass_gate: AUC improvement > 0.01, Brier no worse, and positive AUC increment on at least 6 of 8 historical-test dates

execution_diagnostic.policy: always choose direction from augmented aggressive-flow model probability >= 0.5, one decision per minute
execution_diagnostic.entry: buy at ask or sell at bid of fresh quote at decision+1s
execution_diagnostic.exit: sell at bid or buy at ask of fresh quote at decision+61s
execution_diagnostic.fees: subtract 5 bps per side from crossing return; extra stress subtracts another 5 bps per side
execution_diagnostic.not_a_promotion_gate: reported to distinguish information from executable value; no passive fills assumed

controls: same baseline with no withdrawal or aggression feature
no parameter or horizon selection on validation/test
same-day label eligibility and quote-freshness counts
caveat: All dates are historical and related BTC microstructure outcomes have been studied in this repository; even a passing result would need prospective confirmation.
